description: The last 30 days of delivery attempts for a webhook endpoint — newest first, capped at the supplied limit (max 100). Useful for diagnosing why an endpoint never received (or never acknowledged) an event.

limit.description: Maximum number of deliveries to return (1..100, default 50).

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List Webhook Deliveries
